hook: Lending collateral on Stellar Soroban currently idles within isolated protocol silos.
body: When deposited assets remain locked inside a single venue, they cannot back liquidity elsewhere. Composable credit routing allows collateral to support exposure across separate venues rather than sitting dormant. Blend holds $159,033,033 in TVL, while Soroswap holds $1,239,028 in TVL.
